name: Kitsune
summary: The Fox Mafia's anime fox-girl: !kit chats in text, !kitsune answers in a lip-synced talking video with subtitles.
description:
Kitsune is the bot from the Kitsune repository, as a module. Talk to her with !kit and she answers in text, or with !kitsune and she answers in a short video: her avatar lip-syncs to a NovelAI voice, blinks, and shows one of five moods (happy, mad, neutral, sad, shy) picked from what she says, with subtitles burned in. Her mood also appears as a reaction on your message. Reply to any of her answers to keep talking, in the same mode. She remembers each person (!kitmemory, !kitforget), summarising old chats into notes, and 👍/👎 votes on her answers are kept. !kitface shows an expression. Owners can give the bot her name and picture with !kitprofile, or the button on her dashboard page. List channels under “Chat in these channels” and she answers every message there, no command needed.

Needs: an Ollama API key (ollama.com, free tier works) in the bot's .env as OLLAMA_API_KEY, or a local Ollama. For videos: ffmpeg, a NovelAI token in .env as NOVELAI_TOKEN for her voice, and the Python packages numpy and httpx in the bot's environment (pip install numpy httpx nltk). Without those she still answers in text. This module runs Python, so it needs Settings → Marketplace → Allow modules with code. Her 20 sprite frames (the Fox Mafia's art, 512×512) are downloaded from this marketplace the first time she needs them and kept.

settings.label: Ollama address
settings.help: ollama.com (cloud, needs a key) or your own server, like http://localhost:11434

settings.label: Ollama key variable
settings.help: Name of the .env variable with the Ollama key

settings.label: NovelAI token variable
settings.help: Name of the .env variable with the NovelAI token (her voice)

settings.label: NovelAI voice
settings.help: The voice seed. Her usual voice is Aurae.

settings.label: Sprite host
settings.help: Where her 20 sprite frames are downloaded from, once. A folder path on the bot's computer works too (mood/frame.webp).

settings.label: Only in these channels
settings.help: Names or ids. Leave empty for every channel.

settings.label: Chat in these channels
settings.help: She answers every message here, no command needed (replies included).

settings.label: React with her mood
settings.help: Her mood as an emoji on the message she's answering.

settings.label: How she picks a mood
settings.help: keywords: no download. distilbert: the original model (needs transformers and torch installed).

settings.label: Lip-sync
settings.help: smooth: 24 fps. neku: 16 fps with three mouth levels.
